name: locked_front_micro_dolly
description: Front-locked calibration path for topology-sensitive relief, lattice, material and portrait-anchor motion. Eliminates orbit/roll/yaw so local motion, material response and edge drift can be evaluated independently.

motions.timing_cue: reach maximum at mid-scene and return to 1.0 by the final frame
motions.note: 1.6% micro-dolly peaks at mid-scene and returns to the identical 1.0 endpoint on emitted frame 191; the machine-readable path is closed.
Very low parallax only for regions explicitly declared movable by the control surface. Stationary anchors and background remain fixed.

intent: Make provider failures attributable: any full-object spin, background ripple, large camera orbit, or outer-edge drift is a failure rather than an authored motion cue.
easing_vocabulary: cubic-in-out for the closed micro-dolly; local scene channels retain their own declared easing
